title: Heterogeneity-Aware Client Sampling for Optimal and Efficient Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2505.11304v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) commonly involves clients with diverse communication and computational capabilities. Such heterogeneity can significantly distort the optimization dynamics and lead to objective inconsistency, where the global model converges to an incorrect stationary point potentially far from the pursued optimum. Despite its critical impact, the joint effect of communication and computation heterogeneity has remained largely unexplored, due to the intrinsic complexity of their interaction. In this paper, we reveal the fundamentally distinct mechanisms through which heterogeneous communication and computation drive inconsistency in FL. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first unified theoretical analysis of general heterogeneous FL, offering a principled understanding of how these two forms of heterogeneity jointly distort the optimization trajectory under arbitrary choices of local solvers. translated_title: 面向最优且高效联邦学习的异构感知客户端采样
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）通常涉及具有多样化通信和计算能力的客户端。这种异构性会显著扭曲优化动态并导致目标不一致，即全局模型收敛到一个可能远离所追求最优解的错误驻点。尽管其影响至关重要，但由于通信与计算异构性之间相互作用的内在复杂性，两者的联合效应在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们揭示了异构通信和异构计算驱动联邦学习中不一致性的截然不同的机制。据我们所知，这是首个针对一般异构联邦学习的统一理论分析，为这两种异构性如何在任意局部求解器选择下共同扭曲优化轨迹提供了原则性的理解。基于这些见解……
tldr: 本文首次对一般异构联邦学习进行了统一理论分析，揭示了通信异构性与计算异构性各自导致目标不一致的不同机制，并据此提出异构感知的客户端采样策略，以实现最优且高效的联邦学习。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first unified theoretical analysis of general heterogeneous federated learning, revealing the fundamentally distinct mechanisms by which communication and computation heterogeneity drive objective inconsistency, and proposes heterogeneity-aware client sampling for optimal and efficient FL.
